caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, full-length dress with a fitted bodice and a flared skirt. The dress has a round neckline and features a row of buttons down the front of the bodice. The main fabric pattern is composed of abstract, irregular rectangles and lines in varying shades of green, with hints of light yellow and dark accents integrated throughout. The pattern appears to run vertically and horizontally across the dress. To the right of the main dress illustration, there is a smaller sketch of the same dress showing the back view, which mirrors the pattern and color scheme seen in the front view. The composition is set against a plain, light beige background with no visible additional objects or scenery. In the lower right corner, the name "Rosalie Lane" is written.
title: Dress
